Before --apply, as NEXT-STEPS.md says:
  - the tailnet policy, saved in the admin console (NEXT-STEPS.md step 6)
  - the operator's OAuth client, given with --tailscale-oauth-dir or created as Secret operator-oauth in namespace tailscale (step 6)

--apply would run these 12 steps against the cluster your kubeconfig names, in order, stopping at the first failure:

1. Check that helm runs and release patchy is installed in namespace patchy
     helm version --short
     helm status patchy -n patchy

2. Apply the relay's Dex client secret and the DNS-01 credential in namespace patchy
     kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts --field-manager=patchy-setup-previews -f patchy-previews/secrets/patchy-preview-auth-dex.secret.yaml -f patchy-previews/secrets/preview-dns01-credentials.secret.yaml

3. Apply Dex's copy of the client secret in namespace dex (skipped when no such namespace is here: Dex runs elsewhere)
     kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts --field-manager=patchy-setup-previews -f patchy-previews/secrets/dex-patchy-preview-auth-client.secret.yaml

4. Create namespace tailscale unless it exists
     kubectl create namespace tailscale --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

5. Apply the Tailscale operator's OAuth client, Secret operator-oauth in namespace tailscale
     kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts --field-manager=patchy-setup-previews -f patchy-previews/secrets/tailscale-operator-oauth.secret.yaml

6. Install or upgrade cert-manager v1.21.2 (release cert-manager in namespace cert-manager)
     helm upgrade --install cert-manager cert-manager --repo https://charts.jetstack.io --version v1.21.2 -n cert-manager --create-namespace -f patchy-previews/upstream/cert-manager.values.yaml --wait --timeout 10m0s

7. Apply the Issuer preview-dns01
     kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts --field-manager=patchy-setup-previews -f patchy-previews/manifests/issuer.yaml

8. Apply the Certificate preview-wildcard in namespace patchy
     kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts --field-manager=patchy-setup-previews -f patchy-previews/manifests/certificate.yaml

9. Wait for certificate/preview-wildcard to be Ready
     kubectl -n patchy wait certificate/preview-wildcard --for=condition=Ready --timeout=10m0s

10. Install or upgrade tailscale-operator 1.104.1 (release tailscale-operator in namespace tailscale)
     helm upgrade --install tailscale-operator tailscale-operator --repo https://pkgs.tailscale.com/helmcharts --version 1.104.1 -n tailscale --create-namespace -f patchy-previews/upstream/tailscale-operator.values.yaml --wait --timeout 10m0s

11. Upgrade release patchy to chart 0.12.41 with your values, then patchy-previews.values.yaml
     helm upgrade patchy oci://ghcr.io/devthenet-labs/patchy/charts/patchy --version 0.12.41 -n patchy -f values/patchy.yaml -f patchy-previews/patchy-previews.values.yaml --wait --timeout 10m0s

12. Run the checks of patchy check previews
     patchy check previews -n patchy

Manifests are server-side applied as patchy-setup-previews; a Secret's contents are never printed.

Left to you after it, as NEXT-STEPS.md says:
  - preview nodes, labelled and tainted (NEXT-STEPS.md step 2)
  - preview image pulls on those nodes (step 3)
  - Dex: its static client patchy-preview-auth and the secret's environment variable, then roll Dex (step 4)
  - the two DNS records (step 7)
